title: Synthetic data accelerates the development of generalizable learning-based algorithms for X-ray image analysis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence (AI) now enables automated interpretation of medical images.

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) now enables automated interpretation of medical images.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Synthetic data accelerates the development of generalizable learning-based algorithms for X-ray image analysis》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】We show that training AI image analysis models on realistically synthesized data, combined with contemporary domain generalization techniques, results in machine learning models that on real data perform comparably to models trained on a precisely matched real data training set.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We find that our model transfer paradigm for X-ray image analysis, which we refer to as SyntheX, can even outperform real-data-trained models due to the effectiveness of training on a larger dataset.

evidence.text: We show that training AI image analysis models on realistically synthesized data, combined with contemporary domain generalization techniques, results in machine learning models that on real data perform comparably to models trained on a precisely matched real data training set.
We find that our model transfer paradigm for X-ray image analysis, which we refer to as SyntheX, can even outperform real-data-trained models due to the effectiveness of training on a larger dataset.
